Asset type: specific illustrated catalog contact sheet for original female anime/game character designs.
Primary request: illustrate every listed feature faithfully, each as a DISTINCT reference example.
Layout: EXACTLY 4 equal columns and 4 equal rows in a regular rectangular grid. Cells read left to right then top to bottom. 16 illustrated cells; any remaining trailing cells must be completely blank. Each cell is self-contained with generous gutters. Exact cell ID in small crisp dark sans-serif type at the top left. No other text, no title, no watermark, no logos.
Style: polished professional anime production reference drawings; fine clean outlines, restrained flat colors with minimal cel shadows, light warm ivory background. Detailed enough to identify the named feature. Subject direction: WORN COSMETICS CLOSE-UP on original mature ADULT women age25-40. ONE HUMAN RIGHT EYE, inner corner on viewer-left and outer corner on viewer-right, with complete eyebrow, full upper lid, both corners, upper cheek and space beyond every wing. EYESHADOW: color on real eyelid skin, slightly lowered neutral gaze revealing upper lid; minimal thin natural lashes, NO prominent eyeliner wings or false lashes; no colored iris. Consistent natural brown iris, normal adult eye proportions and realistic eyelid skin in every cell. Clean polished semi-realistic anime illustration, precise cosmetic edges and tiny lashes. NOT isolated palettes, swatches, brushes, packaging, logos, facial injuries or generic eye icons. Use the exact color zones, matte/shimmer/metallic/glitter properties and line shapes described. Every eye corner and brow tip fits inside its own grid cell with generous gutters. No lips, breasts, hands, text other than one exact ID. LANDSCAPE canvas1536x1024, exactly4 columns by4 rows,16 cells, visible fine gray straight separators at quarter axes. No title or footer.
Specific ordered cells:
Cell 1, label ES001: sheer nude-brown lid wash / 裸棕轻雾平涂眼影. Visible feature: 浅裸棕均匀铺在上眼睑，边缘柔和，眉骨与下眼睑保留干净肤色，不画明显眼线。
Cell 2, label ES002: crease-defined eyeshadow / 眼窝弧形加深眼影. Visible feature: 中棕沿眼窝形成柔和弧形带，活动眼皮较浅，向眉骨自然淡出。
Cell 3, label ES003: outer-V eyeshadow / 眼尾外V加深眼影. Visible feature: 外眼角的上睑与眼窝交成深棕V形，内侧眼皮浅米色，边缘晕开。
Cell 4, label ES004: halo eyeshadow / 中央提亮光环眼影. Visible feature: 内眼角与外眼尾各有深棕色，中部留一块清楚的浅香槟亮区，向两侧衔接。
Cell 5, label ES005: inner-to-outer gradient shadow / 横向浅深渐变眼影. Visible feature: 内眼角浅米色过渡到中央暖棕，再到眼尾深巧克力色，沿横向连续变化。
Cell 6, label ES006: lash-to-crease gradient shadow / 纵向烟雾渐变眼影. Visible feature: 靠近上睫毛线是深灰棕，向眼窝逐渐变浅，形成从下到上的柔雾，不画硬截断。
Cell 7, label ES007: full cut-crease eyeshadow / 全截断眼窝眼影. Visible feature: 深棕眼窝弧带下缘是一道干净的弧形边界，整片活动眼皮为浅奶油色，边界与睫毛线分开。
Cell 8, label ES008: half cut-crease eyeshadow / 半截断眼窝眼影. Visible feature: 眼皮内侧半片为浅奶油色截断区域，眼尾深棕保留柔和晕染，形成一半清晰一半烟雾。
Cell 9, label ES009: lower-outer triangle shadow / 下眼尾三角晕染眼影. Visible feature: 上眼睑仅淡裸色，下眼睑外侧三分之一有小棕色三角晕染，与眼尾相接而不铺满眼下。
Cell 10, label ES010: champagne inner-corner highlight / 眼头香槟提亮眼影. Visible feature: 小范围香槟珠光集中在眼头，活动眼皮其余部分为浅棕，不把整只眼或虹膜变亮。
Cell 11, label ES011: matte rose monochrome shadow / 玫瑰哑光单色眼影. Visible feature: 低饱和玫瑰粉铺满活动眼皮，眼窝边缘略深，表面没有闪粉或金属反光。
Cell 12, label ES012: fine champagne shimmer shadow / 香槟细珠光眼影. Visible feature: 浅香槟色有均匀细小反光，眼尾淡棕收边，珠光细腻连续而不是大颗粒亮片。
Cell 13, label ES013: copper metallic eyeshadow / 铜金金属光眼影. Visible feature: 铜金色在活动眼皮形成连贯金属反光面，边缘暖棕晕开，金属色不进入虹膜。
Cell 14, label ES014: scattered glitter eyeshadow / 稀疏亮片点缀眼影. Visible feature: 浅裸棕底上有少量分离的银金亮片，颗粒疏密清楚，与细珠光的连续反光区别明显。
Cell 15, label ES015: blue-violet two-tone shadow / 蓝紫双色晕染眼影. Visible feature: 活动眼皮内侧为蓝色、外侧为紫色，中段柔和衔接，眉骨留白且虹膜仍为自然棕色。
Cell 16, label ES016: geometric color-block shadow / 几何色块图形眼影. Visible feature: 上眼睑橙色块带有清楚平直折角与外侧几何边界，少量肤色留白，不采用烟雾渐层。
Critical constraints: Do not substitute a generic example. The named feature must actually be observable. Read the Chinese feature description if the English phrase is ambiguous. Keep visible structural differences. No character brands or franchise resemblance.
FINAL FRAMING PRIORITY: LANDSCAPE1536x1024,4x4 regular grid. Eye cosmetics must fill each cell. Eye-shadow and eyeliner sheets show ONE eye including its full brow and BOTH corners, with ample room for long wings; complete eye-makeup sheet shows BOTH eyes and brows. Every subject is a mature adult woman. No full head, no full-body figure, no product objects. All irises remain the same natural brown. Gray thin straight grid rules and one legible ID per cell, no other text. Eye-shadow colors and eyeliner paths must match each listing, not16 generic recolors.
